title: How much of a solar plant's 2027 output to sell forward at its one-year P90 once its worn modules are replaced, when only the modules' own wear leaves with them
subdomain: asset-condition-maintenance (a repowered plant's forward energy: the original modules' wear read apart from the dust carried between washes and the inverters' losses, on the days after each wash at the inverters' DC input, then the long-term record's one-year P90)
prompt_shape: a single committed volume with the P50 and standard deviation it rests on, a one-page note with a chart of the 25 weather-year outputs marking the P50 and the volume, and two tables (each inverter's 2025 availability under the O&M agreement; each year's over or under of net energy at the delivery point against the volume sold forward, 2016 to 2025)

sources.origin: constructed for this task by task152/generator/build.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional manufacturer's solar plant in Arizona, its O&M contractor, module suppliers, irrigation district, irradiance provider and trading counterparty, in the layouts of plant SCADA exports, data logger and event exports, a CMMS work order export, utility billing and meter data exports, a trade blotter and confirmations; the weather is simulated for the site; no real organisation's records or person is depicted.
